top_violation_types.title: Basic Requirements for Infants - Never Unsupervised (26 TAC §746.2401(7))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: During the course of an investigation, it was determined that a caregiver would step out of the room to go to the kitchen and leave infants unsupervised.

top_violation_types.title: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment (26 TAC §746.3407)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The ground is splitting open and causing a tripping hazard at the entrance to the playground.       Photos taken

top_violation_types.title: Administering Medication - Original Container with Child's Name, Date (26 TAC §746.3805(b)(1))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Medication was not kept or stored in the original container for a child in care.

top_violation_types.title: Administering Medication - Not After Expiration date (26 TAC §746.3805(b)(3))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: A medication was expired at the time of the inspection.

top_violation_types.title: Nutrition and Food Service - Follow Meal Patterns (26 TAC §746.3301(b))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operation is serving a variety of snacks to children that do not have any nutritional value, and that exceed the allowed amount of sugar per the food program guidelines.
